sync.unsyncedHelp: These lyrics have no sync timings. Auto-scroll, when on, is just an estimate based on the song's length.

audio.pop.label: Visualizer audio source
audio.pop.title: Audio source
audio.pop.body: Spotify plays outside the browser. For the visualizer to react to the music, I listen to the sound coming out of your device. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.
audio.helpSystem: In the browser window, choose Entire screen and turn on Share system audio.
audio.helpMic: On this device you can use the microphone: keep Spotify playing close to it.
audio.err.denied_system: You cancelled the sharing. Nothing was captured.
audio.err.denied_mic: The browser didn't allow the microphone.
audio.err.not_found: I couldn't find any audio input.
audio.err.unsupported: I couldn't access audio in this browser.
audio.err.no_audio: The share came without sound. Choose Entire screen and check Share system audio.
vis.hint.spectrum: Frequency bars with peaks and sparks
vis.hint.particles: A geometric formation that bursts on the bass
vis.hint.geometry: Concentric polygons and a radial spectrum
vis.hint.vector: Stereo L/R field, like in a studio
vis.noSignal.title: Connect the sound and the visualizer will dance.
vis.noSignal.body: Spotify plays outside the browser, so I need to hear what comes out of your device. Every shape on screen comes from real audio: lows, mids and highs.
vis.settings.title: Visualizer
vis.settings.sourceHint: The visualizer only moves with real sound.
vis.settings.ambientHint: With audio connected, the visualizer becomes a soft light behind the lyrics.
vis.settings.captions: Lyrics as captions in Visual mode
vis.settings.captionsHint: Shows the current line and its translation over the visualizer.
vis.settings.gainHint: Raise it if the sound is quiet; lower it if everything maxes out. Saved in this browser only.
onb.welcome.title: Synced lyrics, translated line by line.
onb.welcome.body: You press play on Spotify; I show the lyrics in time with the music and the translation right under each line.
onb.welcome.note: Four quick steps. You can skip now and see them again later in Settings.
onb.connect.title: Connect to Spotify
onb.connect.body: Keep Spotify open and playing on any device: phone, computer or speaker. I read the current song and its position to sync the lyrics.
onb.connect.scopesNote: Only these three permissions. No playlists, email or library. The connection uses Authorization Code with PKCE: no password ever goes through here. Without Spotify the app can't find lyrics, because search uses its catalog.
onb.connect.needsAllowlist: In Development Mode, your account must be added under User Management in the Spotify Developer Dashboard.
onb.connect.idle: Nothing playing right now. If Spotify is closed, open it and play any song.
onb.connect.private: Private session on: Spotify doesn't share the song. Turn it off to see the lyrics.
onb.connect.notMusic: Something that isn't music is playing (podcast or ad).
onb.scope.user-read-currently-playing: Know which song is playing now, to fetch the right lyrics.
onb.scope.user-read-playback-state: Read the song's position and the active device, to sync the lyrics.
onb.scope.user-modify-playback-state: Play, pause, skip and change volume from the player here. Spotify only allows this on Premium accounts.
onb.lang.title: Pick your language
onb.lang.body: It applies to the whole app and to lyric translation. You can change it later from the selector at the top.
onb.done.title: All set. Now just press play.
onb.done.favorite: Like a song? Tap the heart next to its title to save it.
onb.done.favoritesWhere: Your favorites live under the heart at the top and in the library.
onb.done.visual: Press V to switch between the lyrics and the visualizer.
